snapshot.body: Bloom Energy's Force Majeure False Alarm Clears the Way for a 2.4-Gigawatt Oracle Buildout AD HOC NEWS
snapshot.title: Bloom Energy's Force Majeure False Alarm Clears the Way for a 2.4-Gigawatt Oracle Buildout - AD HOC NEWS

w1_final.reason: 消息核心事实为：(1) Oracle force majeure 通知并非真实问题（'false alarm'）；(2) 2.4 GW Oracle 项目照常推进。这些已被 provisional 事实完整覆盖——E114 称 force majeure 是保护合同权利的标准步骤、E229 分析师称其为 proactive legal maneuver 且不影响 Bloom、E232 明确 Oracle 仍 committed 于 2.4 GW 合同。本条为 AD HOC NEWS 的回顾性标题，未增加新的现实进展。

ACPA exempts small ISPs and services with fewer than 100,000 monthly users, public networks, root DNS providers, and TLD providers from blocking obligations.
The full text of ACPA (H.R. 10364) is now publicly available.
ACPA currently sits in the 'introduced' state in Congress with no sponsors, no scheduled hearings, and no markup.
